facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics' Deputy Statistician-General Alieu Saho said the Statistics Act of 2005 governs official statistics and is outdated, calling for its review so a revised law can be in place next year.
National Statistics Council member Sarata Konateh called for full implementation of the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics III, which the article says runs from 2024 to 2028.
